railwayToml:
# Railway staging (Vercel production unchanged).
# Docs: docs/BACKUP_DEPLOYMENT.md, docs/RAILWAY_BUILD_PIPELINE.md
#
# Build strategy: GitHub → Railway DOCKERFILE + Next standalone.

[build]
builder = "DOCKERFILE"
dockerfilePath = "Dockerfile"

[deploy]
startCommand = "node server.js"
healthcheckPath = "/api/health"
healthcheckTimeout = 180
restartPolicyType = "ON_FAILURE"
restartPolicyMaxRetries = 3

branchMapping.detachedCommitOverride: no evidence of GitHub Action override; no .github/workflows found
